Olga Tokarczuk won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2018 and her novel *The Books of Jacob* was shortlisted for the International Booker Prize in 2022.  
Annie Ernaux won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2022 and was shortlisted for the International Booker Prize in 2019 for her book *The Years*.
